info.name: INVEX Backend API
info.description:
Admin panel API, user app API, Alpaca stock trading + market data, and the MT5 bridge.

Quick start:
1. Edit the collection Variables: baseUrl, adminEmail, adminPassword (from your .env / npm run seed), mt5Key (MT5_WEBHOOK_KEY).
2. Run the folder '1 · Start here' (Run collection → pick that folder). It logs in as admin, registers a test user, funds the wallet and creates a pending deposit, a pending withdrawal and an open stock order. Tokens and ids are saved automatically.
3. Then use '2 · Admin Panel API' and '3 · User App API' in any order. Requests marked '(saves …)' fill the variables the others use ({{userId}}, {{depositId}}, {{rankId}}, …).
4. Market data and stock trading need ALPACA_KEY_ID / ALPACA_SECRET_KEY in the backend .env (otherwise 503: provider not configured).
5. Admin Approve/Reject on one deposit or withdrawal can only be used once (409 'Already processed' afterwards).
